Gluten-Free Soft Turkey Tacos
By: Robin Duke
Published: Wednesday, October 23, 2013 - 11:21am

Ingredients




5 slices Piller's Simply Free Roasted Turkey Breast, cut into strips
4 soft corn tortillas
125 ml (½ cup) lettuce, shredded
60 ml (¼ cup) carrots, cut into matchsticks
30 ml (2 Tbsp.) extra virgin olive oil
15 ml (1 Tbsp.) cilantro, finely chopped
Juice of one lime
Salt and pepper

Preparation

1 In a large mixing bowl combine lettuce, carrots, cilantro, olive oil, lime juice, and salt and pepper to taste. 2 Lay out tortillas and divide mixture among tortillas; top with turkey breast strips. 3 Fold in half and enjoy.
